name: Svikv
source:
The game is a metaphor about the state of refugees in Western Ukraine in the first period after the full-scale Russian military invasion.

[Translated from [url=https://bozhkovolodymyr.itch.io/svikv]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
這部遊戲以隱喻描繪了俄羅斯軍隊發動全面入侵之初，烏克蘭西部難民的處境。

［譯自[url=https://bozhkovolodymyr.itch.io/svikv]itch.io[/url]］
